verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Salesforce publishes an llms.txt at https://www.salesforce.com/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with curated markdown links an agent can follow, which meets the story's core. The probe excerpt only shows marketing and training content, such as an AI agent course link, so it is unclear whether the file covers Sales Cloud developer or API documentation. missing for 10: evidence that llms.txt or agent-oriented docs cover Sales Cloud developer/API reference content, an llms-full.txt or markdown doc variants, and independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can use it effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
